{{Quote|Shoja Ko. Former overseer of all spice gangs on Plexis. We give you... smallest bounty for him. Plexis is not huge planet.|Nogba Quush, to Riley's [[The Smuggler|sibling]]|<ref name="SWU" />}}
'''Plexis''' was a relatively small [[planet]]<ref name="SWU">''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]''</ref> located in the [[Plexis system]] in the [[Core Worlds]] region of [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Appendix" /> During the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], it housed a number of [[spice]] gangs, all of which were under the authority of the [[Zenowai Crime Society]] via an overseer named [[Shoja Ko]].<ref name="SWU" /> [[Telgordo Travel]] ran travel services from [[Coruscant]] to Plexis, [[Hosnian Prime]], and [[Eufornis Major]] from the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]].<ref name="Aldhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref>

By [[3 ABY]],<ref name="OutlawsDate">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> a [[viper probe droid]] designated [[Viper 071-V-8852]] had been sent to Plexis where it undertook an eight [[Standard week|week]] mission to observe the [[spaceport]] and recorded any activity of spice or [[weapon]]s [[Smuggler|smuggling]].<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>
